description: This file defines a UI component named 'Editor' using the Lightning JavaScript framework. It displays and allows editing of note details, including title and body, and provides Save and Delete buttons with associated actions. The component manages its internal state, handles user input, and emits events for saving and deleting notes.

classes.name: Editor
classes.description: A Lightning component for editing and displaying note information with interactive save and delete buttons.

methods.name: watch.note
methods.description: Watches for changes in the note prop and syncs internal buffers.

methods.name: computed.titleDisplay
methods.description: Returns the display string for the note title, appending cursor indicator if focused.

methods.name: computed.bodyDisplay
methods.description: Returns the display string for the note body, including cursor indicator if focused.

methods.name: $emitSave
methods.description: Emits a 'save' event with current note data to save changes.

methods.name: $emitDelete
methods.description: Emits a 'delete' event with the current note ID to delete the note.

calls: this.$emit('save', { id: this._id, title: this._title || 'Untitled', body: this._body || '' })
